intent.raw: Review the reading-learning-package development plan for gaps before implementation.
intent.objective: Create an implementation-readiness review route for the reading-learning-package spell plan, stopping before runtime-backed execution until confirmed.
intent.operator_sentence: see if we have any gaps and do a review in the plan so we can implement

route_menu.context_hint: The operator asked for a gap review before implementation. The selected route is a sequential Refine review with a hard approval checkpoint before runtime-backed stages.

items.label: Plan Readiness Review
items.description: Use the route_menu technique to select a source-local refine loop that reviews the package before implementation.

items.label: Spellcraft First
items.description: Defer detailed plan review until a spellcraft package is installed, useful only if canonical spell shape is the current blocker.

items.label: Implementation SWU
items.description: Convert directly into a Task Session work unit, useful only after gaps are known to be minor.

technique_overlays.trigger: The review needs ordered evidence flow from package context to final plan repair.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every non-first step consumes a prior frame, artifact, ledger, or decision, and every evidence claim cites a concrete path.

technique_overlays.trigger: Implementation should not start until missing decisions and owner-boundary issues are explicit.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Review output must classify gaps as ready, repair-needed, or blocked, with recomposition proof back to the reading-learning-package objective.

technique_overlays.trigger: The route must distinguish development evidence from canonical spell installation and runtime execution.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Trace events, source paths, stage artifacts, and future canonical writes stay in separate named namespaces.

subagent_strategy.explanation: The initial plan review is source-local and does not require delegated sibling agents. If the review discovers contested lanes, a later dispatch can ask for explicit subagent permission.

steps.name: Build Package Context Pack
stop_conditions: Block if required source artifacts are missing or unreadable.
Flag if a source artifact has no clear owner role.

steps.name: Review Definition And Scope
stop_conditions: Block if the review cannot distinguish spell intent from canonical installation.
Flag if the preset-interview contract is not grounded in examples.

steps.name: Interview For Plan Gaps
stop_conditions: Block if a required implementation decision has no owner or next route.
Flag if a gap can be repaired locally without external research.

steps.name: Decide Whether External Research Is Needed
stop_conditions: Ask before any external research.
Block if a gap requires source evidence that the package does not currently provide.

steps.name: Distill Smallest Review Unit
stop_conditions: Block if the smallest review unit cannot recompose into the spell objective.
Flag if more than one independent repair unit is discovered.

steps.name: Repair Design Or Defer With Owner
stop_conditions: Block if repair would require canonical spell writes before review result.
Flag if a renderer, interview, or PDF contract remains underspecified.

steps.name: Validate Design Repair
stop_conditions: Block if design repair contradicts the source package objective.
Flag if acceptance criteria still cannot be tested.

steps.name: Distill Repair Residue
stop_conditions: Block if residue has no owner or next-route recommendation.
Flag if a residual gap can be left as a documented deferred task.

steps.name: Repair Implementation Plan
stop_conditions: Block if the repaired plan lacks a verification surface.
Flag if canonical installation, Task Session, or spellcraft order remains ambiguous.

steps.name: Synthesize Readiness Result
stop_conditions: Block if final status is not implementation-ready, repair-needed, or blocked.
Stop before runtime-backed implementation unless the operator explicitly approves execution.

gates.condition: Required source artifacts in the reading-learning-package development package are readable and cited by concrete_path_evidence.
owner_boundary_check confirms the review does not claim research-tower, whisper, spellcraft, or task-session authority.
Every runtime-backed stage must return a native stage receipt with dispatch id, step id, capability ref, status, artifacts, validation, observer status, blockers, residue, and handoff note.
approval_checkpoint requires explicit approval before any external research is run.
approval_checkpoint requires explicit approval before this dispatch executes runtime-backed stages.
state_namespace_boundary keeps development evidence, generated review stages, and future canonical spell writes separate.
Final RESULT.md classifies the plan as implementation-ready, repair-needed, or blocked and records residue_ledger entries.

authority.lifecycle: refine owns this review route and its stop point.
authority.execution: native capabilities own their runtime stage receipts only after operator approval.
authority.validation: dispatch-spec validates route shape; refine synthesizes readiness result.
authority.evidence: source package artifacts and generated review stages remain linked by path.
authority.memory: memory can inform route shape but cannot alter package artifacts without a visible edit.
authority.promotion: canonical spell installation remains deferred to spellcraft or an explicit implementation route.

boundaries.contract: Source artifacts are read and cited by path; review artifacts do not rewrite them during the strategy proposal stage.
Runtime-backed stages start only after explicit operator confirmation.
Each stage returns a native-stage receipt with status, artifacts, validation, blockers, residue, and handoff note.
Generated review evidence stays under the refinement run; source package edits require a visible repair artifact or later implementation route.

state_namespaces.write_policy: read-only during strategy proposal; source edits require an explicit repair step
generated review evidence is written under this run directory
no canonical spell writes until a later approved route
no implementation writes from this strategy proposal

promotion_splits.rule: Review evidence can recommend next action but requires a separate spellcraft or implementation approval before canonical spell writes.

promotion_guardrails: This route must not claim canonical spell installation authority.
This route must not turn review evidence into package source edits without an explicit repair stage.
This route must not start external research without operator approval.
This route must not start runtime-backed stages without operator approval.
